verdict.rationale: Dots is an always-on cloud agent with its own browser. It can find relevant email, read documents and delegate work to ChatGPT Work or Codex. However, no evidence describes a deep research mode that autonomously searches many sources and returns a cited report. General agent and browser abilities are adjacent capabilities, not the story's capability.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can launch a deep research run that autonomously searches many sources and returns a cited report
